name: Oasis

whyMatters.en: Manchester Britpop band formed in 1991. Definitely Maybe (1994) and (What’s the Story) Morning Glory? (1995) put loud, Beatles-citing guitar songs back on mid-90s UK charts while US alternative radio favored grunge.
whyMatters.zh: 曼彻斯特 Britpop 乐队，1991 年成立。《Definitely Maybe》（1994）与《(What’s the Story) Morning Glory?》（1995）以大声、引用 Beatles 的吉他歌曲占据 90 年代中期英国榜；同期美国 alternative 电台以 grunge 为主。

note.en: Definitely Maybe–era single; mid-tempo, melody forward, wide guitars.
note.zh: 《Definitely Maybe》时期单曲；中速、旋律靠前、吉他铺得宽。

note.en: From Morning Glory; acoustic strum figure, Liam vocal, singalong chorus; major international hit.
note.zh: 出自《Morning Glory》；原声扫弦音型、Liam 人声、合唱副歌；重要国际热单。

interviewQuotes.speaker: Noel Gallagher

interviewQuotes.text: Noel writes them. I sing them like I mean every word.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Liam Gallagher

lyricQuotes: Maybe you're gonna be the one that saves me

shortBio.en: Gallagher brothers Britpop, 1991–2009. Wonderwall and Live Forever are the main mass-market references.
shortBio.zh: Gallagher 兄弟的 Britpop，1991–2009。《Wonderwall》与《Live Forever》是主要大众参照。

body.en:
Oasis formed in Manchester in 1991. Noel Gallagher wrote the songs; Liam Gallagher sang in a mid-range, nasal delivery. Definitely Maybe (1994) and (What’s the Story) Morning Glory? (1995) fixed open chords, loud mixes, and large choruses as the band’s core sound.

Live Forever (1994) and Wonderwall / Don’t Look Back in Anger (1995) are the best-known singles. Sibling conflict and rhythm-section changes are well documented; Creation Records released the peak albums. The band split in 2009.

Before Noel joined, Liam, Paul “Bonehead” Arthurs, Paul “Guigsy” McGuigan, and Tony McCarroll were The Rain. Noel renamed them Oasis and wrote the songs. Definitely Maybe (1994) is, in the book’s line, the fastest-selling UK debut to that date. The entry sets Live Forever against Nirvana’s Lithium. Noel fired McCarroll because, in the Chinese edition, he could not play the new drums. Alan White, brother of Paul Weller sideman Steve White, replaced him. (What’s the Story) Morning Glory? (1995) reached US #4. Wonderwall and Champagne Supernova are the singles. Two Knebworth Park shows in 1996 are the live node. John Squire of The Stone Roses sat in. Ian Brown, Chinese-edition wording, called them cocaine addicts wasting everyone’s time.

Be Here Now (1997) hit UK #1 and US #2. Arthurs and McGuigan left before Standing on the Shoulder of Giants (2000). Gem Archer came from Heavy Stereo; Andy Bell from Ride and Hurricane #1. After Heathen Chemistry (2002), Zak Starkey, Ringo Starr’s son, replaced White. Dig Out Your Soul is 2008. A fight in Paris ended the band in 2009. Noel’s line, Chinese edition: he could not work with Liam another day. Liam then formed Beady Eye with Bell, Archer, and Chris Sharrock. Noel formed High Flying Birds.
body.zh:
Oasis 于 1991 年在曼彻斯特成立。Noel Gallagher 写歌；Liam Gallagher 以中音区、鼻音式唱法演唱。《Definitely Maybe》（1994）与《(What’s the Story) Morning Glory?》（1995）定型开放和弦、大声混音与大副歌。

《Live Forever》（1994）与《Wonderwall》/《Don’t Look Back in Anger》（1995）是最知名单曲。兄弟争执与节奏组变动有大量记录；巅峰专辑由 Creation Records 发行。乐队于 2009 年解散。

Noel 加入之前，Liam、Paul “Bonehead” Arthurs、Paul “Guigsy” McGuigan 与 Tony McCarroll 是 The Rain。Noel 把乐队改名 Oasis，并写歌。《Definitely Maybe》（1994）在书中被写成当时英国卖得最快的首张专辑。条目把《Live Forever》放在 Nirvana《Lithium》对面。Noel 开除 McCarroll。中文版所引 Noel：他打不了新歌的鼓。接替者是 Alan White，Paul Weller 乐手 Steve White 的兄弟。《(What’s the Story) Morning Glory?》（1995）美国榜第 4。单曲是《Wonderwall》与《Champagne Supernova》。1996 年内布沃斯公园两场是条目里的现场。The Stone Roses 的 John Squire 同台。中文版所引 Ian Brown：他们是可卡因瘾君子，在浪费大家的时间。

《Be Here Now》（1997）英国榜首、美国第 2。Arthurs 与 McGuigan 在《Standing on the Shoulder of Giants》（2000）之前离开。Gem Archer 来自 Heavy Stereo；Andy Bell 来自 Ride 与 Hurricane #1。《Heathen Chemistry》（2002）之后，Ringo Starr 的儿子 Zak Starkey 接替 White。《Dig Out Your Soul》是 2008 年。2009 年巴黎一场争执后乐队结束。中文版所引 Noel：他没法再和 Liam 多干一天。Liam 随后与 Bell、Archer、Chris Sharrock 组成 Beady Eye。Noel 组成 High Flying Birds。

title.en: Loud guitar Britpop on UK charts
title.zh: 英国榜上的大声吉他 Britpop

body.en:
Oasis used open chords, loud guitar mixes, northern English vocals, and clear verse/chorus shapes. Songwriting often cites 1960s UK pop (Beatles) and Madchester guitar bands (Stone Roses).

In the mid-1990s that approach sat on UK charts while US alternative radio still leaned toward grunge.
body.zh:
Oasis 使用开放和弦、大声吉他混音、英格兰北方人声，以及清楚的主副歌结构。写歌常引用 1960 年代英国流行（Beatles）与 Madchester 吉他乐队（Stone Roses）。

90 年代中期这套写法占据英国榜，同期美国 alternative 电台仍偏 grunge。

body.en:
Noel and Liam Gallagher remain the constant core. Guitarists, bassists, and drummers change across the Britpop peak and later years.

The 1995–1999 five-piece with Paul Arthurs, Paul McGuigan, and Alan White is the best-known early lineup.

The Rain four become Oasis when Noel joins. Squire’s guest spot at Knebworth ties the band to The Stone Roses. Ride’s Andy Bell is the later bass.
body.zh:
Noel 与 Liam Gallagher 是固定核心。吉他手、贝斯手与鼓手在 Britpop 巅峰与后期多有更换。

1995–1999 与 Paul Arthurs、Paul McGuigan、Alan White 组成的五人组是最熟悉的早期阵容。

Noel 加入后，The Rain 四人组变成 Oasis。内布沃斯上 Squire 的客串把他们和 The Stone Roses 连在一起。后来的贝斯是 Ride 的 Andy Bell。

alt.en: Liam Gallagher with Oasis, Stadium of Light, Sunderland, 10 June 2009
alt.zh: Liam Gallagher 与 Oasis，桑德兰光明球场，2009 年 6 月 10 日

body.en:
Live Forever is a Definitely Maybe–era statement single: melody up front, wide guitars, lyric confidence without metal gloom.

It is one of the clearest early examples of the band’s mid-tempo writing.
body.zh:
《Live Forever》是《Definitely Maybe》时期的声明式单曲：旋律靠前、吉他宽、歌词自信，无金属阴郁。

是乐队早期中速写法的清晰例子。

body.en:
Wonderwall centers on a strummed acoustic figure, Liam’s vocal, and a singalong chorus. The arrangement stays simple on purpose.

It became the band’s best-known international single beyond the UK Britpop press cycle.
body.zh:
《Wonderwall》以原声扫弦音型、Liam 人声与合唱副歌为主。编曲故意保持简单。

成为乐队在英国 Britpop 媒体周期之外最知名的国际单曲。

body.en:
Chord moves and vocal phrasing often cite 1960s UK pop. Swagger and baggy-era residue cite Madchester, especially The Stone Roses.

2000s UK indie anthem bands frequently name Oasis as a direct reference.
body.zh:
和弦进行与人声句式常引用 1960 年代英国流行。姿态与 baggy 时期残余引用 Madchester，尤其是 The Stone Roses。

2000 年代英国 indie 颂歌乐队常直接点名 Oasis。

body.en:
Press feuds with Blur and between the brothers are part of the public record. They document attitude and publicity; musical judgment still returns to the singles and albums.

Noel’s and Liam’s interview lines are often quoted as scene sociology.
body.zh:
与 Blur 及兄弟间的媒体争执属公开记录。它们记录态度与宣传；音乐判断仍回到单曲与专辑。

Noel 与 Liam 的访谈句常被用作场景社会学材料。

note.en:
Best-known peak five-piece before later fractures.

McCarroll drums through Definitely Maybe. White plays Morning Glory and the 1996 Knebworth shows.
note.zh:
后期分裂前最熟悉的巅峰五人组。

McCarroll 打到《Definitely Maybe》。White 打《Morning Glory》和 1996 年内布沃斯。

note.en:
Name continues; guitar and bass seats change (Gem Archer, Andy Bell, and others).

Archer and Bell replace Arthurs and McGuigan. Starkey, then Sharrock, replace White. Split is 2009.
note.zh:
名称延续；吉他与贝斯席位更换（Gem Archer、Andy Bell 等）。

Archer 与 Bell 接替 Arthurs 和 McGuigan。Starkey，然后是 Sharrock，接替 White。2009 年结束。

note.en: Beatles-citing song craft and loud guitar choruses on mid-90s UK charts.
note.zh: 引用 Beatles 的写歌与大声吉他副歌，占据 90 年代中期英国榜。
